issues.description: Missing key prop in list rendering. Using array index as key can cause issues with dynamic lists.
issues.suggestion: Add unique ID from todo object as key: <li key={todo.id}> instead of <li key={index}>

issues.description: Inline event handler function creates new function on every render, impacting performance.
issues.suggestion: Extract to useCallback hook or move to a named function outside JSX
Align imports with project style guide for consistency

codeQuality.summary: Component has functional logic but contains performance concerns and best practice violations. Key prop issue could cause subtle bugs with list manipulation.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Delete functionality lacks test coverage for error scenarios
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test deletion failure handling and state rollback

untestedPaths.reasoning: Empty list state not covered by tests
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Add test for rendering with empty todo array

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for toggling completion status

testCoverage.summary: Basic happy path is tested but edge cases and error handling lack coverage. Missing tests for empty states and error scenarios.

suggestions.description: Extract TodoItem rendering logic into separate component

suggestions.description: Update to use modern React hooks pattern consistently
suggestions.after:

const handleDelete = useCallback((id) => { ... }, [todos]);

refactorings.summary: Component would benefit from extracting TodoItem to separate component and optimizing callbacks with useCallback hook.

issues.description: Missing input validation on todoText parameter. Could allow injection attacks if data is used in HTML context.
issues.suggestion: Add validation: if (!todoText || typeof todoText !== 'string') throw new Error('Invalid todo text')

issues.description: Error messages are too generic and don't provide useful debugging information.
issues.suggestion: Include context in errors: throw new Error(`Failed to fetch todos: ${error.message}`)

issues.description: No timeout handling for API calls, could hang indefinitely.
issues.suggestion: Implement fetch timeout with AbortController or axios timeout configuration

codeQuality.summary: Service layer lacks input validation and error handling robustness. Security concerns with unvalidated user input.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No validation tests for empty or malicious input
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test with null, undefined, empty string, XSS payload inputs

untestedPaths.reasoning: Missing test for invalid ID format

testCoverage.summary: Only happy path scenarios are tested. Critical gap in error handling and input validation test coverage.

suggestions.description: Implement custom error class for better error handling

codeQuality.summary: Main App component functions correctly but shows early signs of maintainability issues. Architecture decisions need review for future scalability.

testCoverage.summary: Component lifecycle and state transitions need better test coverage.

recommendations.description: Implement comprehensive input validation across all services. Add validation for todo text to prevent injection attacks.
Fix array index as key issue in TodoList component. Use unique todo IDs instead to prevent list manipulation bugs.
Increase test coverage for edge cases and error scenarios. Add tests for empty states, API failures, and invalid inputs.
Extract TodoItem into separate component and implement custom hook for data fetching. This will improve code organization and testability.
Optimize re-renders by using useCallback for event handlers and preventing inline function creation.
